input.free_text_description: This system is a messaging platform that serves Admin, Content Creator roles. The platform provides capabilities for abstract socket event handler. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include e-commerce functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to use abstract socket event handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Content Creator, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Admin, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
As a Content Creator, I want to export data in a standard format, so that I can use it in external tools.
